annotations.title: Checked travel knowledge for a destination

description: Use when the user asks about the destination itself rather than a hotel, e.g. the best time to travel or the climate per season: hoteldiscount24's checked travel knowledge for the place, the same text Mercan uses in its chat. has_knowledge=false means there is no checked text for this place and topic — say so, do not guess.

language.description: The user's language: de, en or tr (default en).

topic.description: Topic: anreise = Getting there & around; ausfluege = Day trips & activities; einkaufen = Shopping & markets; essen = Food & drink; feste = Festivals & events; gut_zu_wissen = Good to know; kunst_kultur = Art & culture; nachtleben = Nightlife & going out; reisezeit = Best time to travel & climate; stadtteile = Neighbourhoods & where to stay; strand = Beaches & swimming; wintersport = Winter sports.

name: get_travel_knowledge
